craft_notes: Sthāyin: wonder at streaming radiance (vismaya; C1 bhakti-vismaya). Sanskrit first: four datives cascade with no verb but namas — prasarad (flowing-forth, pres part, motion kept), bindu-nāda (drop-resonance), śuddhāmṛtamaya-ātman (nectar-self), ananta-prakāśa (endless light), śaṅkara-kṣīra-sindhu (milk-ocean). Feel: liquid light pouring one way — everything flows toward. Firing rows: compounds held whole in cascade, never split (row 2 refused — the pour IS the meaning); no verb to end-weight (namas implied — hail kept mid-verse as the pour's turn); vowel music liquid i/u/a with no hard stops (row 8); vast-still close on 'milk-white sea' (row 12 adapted: vastness settles, not quiescence); Vṛtti's śleṣa (milk-ocean white/nectar/Nāgarāja) and family ākhyāyikā noted, never imported — image left standing (row 10); no vocative to invent (row 7 silent). Bright-check: what shines — drop, hum, nectar, light, milk-white sea; all kept glowing, nothing explained. Minimal pass: semicolon→comma after 'hail' (invocation softens, light released); zero diction changes. Read aloud: line 1 pours without check (four datives, breath unbroken); line 2 receives it into vastness; it scans. Rejected: 'bubbling' for 'welling' — killed: prasarad is forth-flowing, welling keeps the rise; 'chant' for 'hum' — killed: nāda is resonance, hum holds it; splitting datives across the break — killed: easing the pour the Sanskrit never checks; naming the light ('O endless Light!') — killed: vocative un-Sanskrit plus stating the suggested (double fault); 'milk ocean' unhyphenated — killed: hyphen-chain carries the compound (row 2); explaining bindu-nāda (Vṛtti jñāna-kriyā) — killed: doctrine belongs to argmap/NOTE, song carries image only. Voice continues (v01 verdict pending; same hand, same music).

lines: To the welling drop and hum, to the self of sheer nectar, hail,
to light unending, to Śaṅkara, the milk-white sea.

reads_against.argmap: Forth-flowing drop-resonance; pure-nectar self.; Endless light; Śaṅkara milk-ocean. → Bow to Śaṅkara milk-ocean, pure-nectar self, endless light.
c1_essence: Milk-ocean Śaṅkara bowed; hate and praise both address Ambikā's husband who holds the all.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-vismaya (devotion charged with wonder); sthayibhava utsāha-in-bhakti
